shortDescription: List extracted value rules for a Semaphore integration

options.name: api_token
options.description: Bearer API token for authentication. Use this or C(session_cookie).

options.name: host
options.description: Base URL of the Semaphore server (e.g. C(http://localhost)).

options.name: integration_id
options.description: ID of the integration whose extracted values should be listed.

options.name: port
options.description: Port where the Semaphore API is exposed (e.g. C(3000)).

options.name: project_id
options.description: ID of the project that owns the integration.

options.name: session_cookie
options.description: Session cookie for authentication. Use this or C(api_token).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate TLS certificates when using HTTPS.
